fact: UNFPA states that Presidential Decree 25/2025 of 3 March was promulgated and a first tranche of 1,043,332,784 XAF released for census preparatory work (cartography), with the fifth census to be carried out in 2026.
title: Recrutement d'un Conseiller Technique Principal du 5ème Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitat (RGPH) de la Guinée Equatoriale
